fee_notes: Single Store: $50,000 lump sum (uniform for all single-franchise purchasers). Reduced by $5,000 for VetFran-qualified franchisees or franchise entities at least 51% woman or minority owned, making the effective single-Store fee as low as $45,000 with that discount. For Development Agreements (multiple Stores), the per-unit Development Fee replaces the Initial Franchise Fee: $45,000/unit for 2 units, $40,000/unit for 3-5 units, $35,000/unit for 6+ units (total Development Fee reduced by $5,000 for VetFran-qualified). An additional $8,000 initial training fee applies for the first Store. The fee range reported here reflects the single-Store standard fee ($50,000 high) down to the per-unit development fee floor ($35,000/unit for 6+ units); the low is set to $45,000 representing the most common discounted/multi-unit starting point. All fees are non-refundable and deemed fully earned upon execution.
raw_excerpt:
When you purchase the right to develop a single Store, at the time you sign the Franchise Agreement, you will pay us an Initial Franchise Fee of $ 50,000 in a lump sum . If you qualify for the VetFran program sponsored by the International Franchise Association ("IFA") or if your franchise entity is at least 51% woman or minority owned, the Initial Franchise Fee you pay for a single Store will be reduced by $5,000. ... Initial Franchise Fees  Number of Franchised Units
$45,000 per unit two (2) franchised units
$40,000 per unit  three (3) to five (5) franchised units
$35,000 per unit six (6) or more franchised units
